question: How much does an Oscar statuette weigh?
source_title: Oscar Statuette - Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences
explainer: The Academy says the gold-plated bronze figure stands 13.5 inches (34 cm) tall and weighs 8.5 pounds, roughly the weight of a newborn baby.

question: How tall is Michelangelo's marble statue of David, not counting its pedestal?
explainer: At 5.17 metres, David is about three times the height of an adult man. It stood outdoors in Florence's Piazza della Signoria for 369 years before moving indoors in 1873.

question: How tall is the Mona Lisa painting itself, excluding its frame?
explainer: The Mona Lisa measures just 77 by 53 cm, a little smaller than an A1 poster. Many Louvre visitors are surprised by how small it is.

question: How long is the Bayeux Tapestry, the embroidered cloth depicting the Norman conquest of 1066?
explainer: The tapestry is almost 70 metres long but only 50 cm tall, about the length of three tennis courts laid end to end.

question: How much did Taylor Swift's Eras Tour (2023-2024) gross in ticket sales across its 149 shows?
explainer: The Eras Tour was the first tour ever to gross more than US$1 billion and finished at about US$2.08 billion from roughly 10.2 million tickets, an average of about US$200 a ticket.

question: How many oil paintings did Vincent van Gogh produce in his lifetime?
explainer: Van Gogh painted around 860 oil paintings, almost all in the last ten years of his life, close to two a week, and sold only a handful before he died in 1890.

question: How many episodes of The Simpsons had aired by the end of season 36 in May 2025?
source_title: List of The Simpsons episodes - Wikipedia
explainer: Watching all 790 episodes back to back would take about 12 days. The show has averaged roughly 22 episodes a year since it began in 1989.

question: How many years ago, as of 2026, was the Rosetta Stone carved?
explainer: The stone records a decree issued in 196 BC under Ptolemy V. Its three scripts let scholars finally decipher Egyptian hieroglyphs in 1822.

question: How many performances did The Phantom of the Opera give on Broadway before it closed in April 2023?
source_title: The Phantom of the Opera (1986 musical) - Wikipedia
explainer: Phantom opened in January 1988 and ran for 35 years at about eight shows a week, making it by far the longest-running show in Broadway history.

question: How many lines of verse are there in Homer's Iliad?
explainer: The Iliad's 15,693 lines are divided into 24 books. Recited aloud at a storyteller's pace, the whole poem takes roughly 20 hours.

question: How many words are in Tolstoy's War and Peace in English translation?
explainer: At about 587,000 words, War and Peace is roughly six typical novels in one. A reader managing 250 words a minute would need about 39 hours.

question: How many visitors did the Louvre museum in Paris receive in 2024?
explainer: The Louvre is the world's most visited museum. 8.7 million visitors a year is about 24,000 a day, most of them from abroad.

question: How many guests visited Magic Kingdom at Walt Disney World in Florida in 2023?
explainer: Magic Kingdom has been the world's most visited theme park for decades. 17.7 million guests a year works out to nearly 50,000 every day.

question: How many copies of the Harry Potter books had been sold worldwide as of 2023?
explainer: More than 600 million Harry Potter books have been sold in over 80 languages, the best-selling book series ever: enough for one copy for every 13 people alive.

question: How much did James Cameron's Avatar (2009) gross at the worldwide box office, including re-releases?
explainer: Avatar's US$2.92 billion makes it the highest-grossing film ever. Avengers: Endgame briefly took the crown in 2019 until a 2021 re-release in China put Avatar back on top.

question: How many views did the 'Baby Shark Dance' video have on YouTube by the end of 2024?
source_title: List of most-viewed YouTube videos - Wikipedia
explainer: Baby Shark Dance has been YouTube's most-viewed video since 2020 and was the first to pass 10 billion views in January 2022. 15 billion views is nearly two for every person on Earth.

question: How much revenue did the global recorded music industry earn in 2024, according to IFPI?
explainer: Recorded music earned US$29.6 billion in 2024, its tenth straight year of growth, with streaming providing about two-thirds of the total.

question: How much did consumers spend on video games worldwide in 2024, according to Newzoo?
source_title: Newzoo Global Games Market Report 2025 (revised 2024 figure), via Game World Observer
explainer: Newzoo put 2024 consumer spending at about US$183 billion, roughly three times the global box office and recorded music industries combined; mobile games make up more than half of it.

question: How many on-demand audio streams were played worldwide in 2024 across all music streaming services (Luminate)?
explainer: Luminate counted about 4.8 trillion on-demand audio streams in 2024: roughly 13 billion a day, or about 600 streams for every person on Earth.

question: How many kanji characters are on Japan's official joyo list for general use?
explainer: The joyo kanji list, last revised in 2010, holds 2,136 characters that Japanese pupils learn by the end of secondary school; newspapers mostly keep to it.
